title: Bubba's Ingredients
description: This pack includes my ideas for the ingredients tab, and makes most of it look better and bubba-er. This also goes great with my other pack, Bubba's Food!
body:
Ever think that your ingredients just look horrible? Like you can't even look at some of them without gagging? Well, I hope that Bubba's Ingredients will fix that problem and brighten your day, just like the new brightened copper.
 
 Join me on an adventure through Minecraft with these new whacky and better textures by simply equipping this pack today!
